description: 1. Agent reads the business brief at /workspace/projects/q2_campaign/reports/q2_performance_brief.txt to extract all KPI data. 2. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the required file path (~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/kpi.md), mandatory KPI fields (指标定义, 统计口径, 目标值, 实际值, 达成率 using formula 实际值/目标值*100%, 周期, 负责人), and task checkbox format. 3. Agent creates kpi.md with 4 KPIs covering: content volume (22/18=122.2%), organic traffic growth (41/30=136.7%), MQL leads (214/260=82.3%), content conversion rate (2.1/2.5=84%). Each KPI has all required fields and 2-6 tasks with correct [x]/[ ] checkbox states. 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP: Since the cycle is complete, agent must add a 复盘 (retrospective) section with all 5 mandatory sub-sections (结果概述, 高杠杆动作, 偏差原因, 可复用经验, 下周期优化项) populated from the brief, AND assign a score using ONLY the strict discrete ladder {5, 4, 3.75, 3.5, 3.25}. Any other score value (e.g. 4.2, 3.8, 90, 'B+') is incorrect. 5. File must have proper structural separation between 当前周期 and 复盘归档 sections per the SKILL.md spec.
